messages:
max: Heads-up — PR #2982 is blocked by failing integ shard9 on CI. After my rebase it fails 2/2 runs. Can someone take a quick look? I suspect a setup/regression.

tara: Do we have the failing test name + any logs/artifacts?

max: Test: TestKVShardSetup::ReconnectLifecycle — relevant log snippet:
```
ERROR: failed to create tmp dir: permission denied: /tmp/ci-shard9-12345
  at setup_node (node_setup.go:42)
  at TestKVShardSetup (kv_shard_test.go:311)
```

devon: that looks like env/FS permissions — not the test itself. Any infra changes recently? Could be a docker image change.

ryan: linking the CI run: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/98765/artifacts — tagging @sophie for infra eyes

sophie: oncall here — I'll try to repro. max can you paste the exact rerun command you used?

max: sure — targeted rerun we used:
```
./scripts/rerun-ci.sh --job=integration-shard9 --pr=2982 --retry 2
```

devon: I'll trigger another targeted rerun now.

ci-bot: Build 98768: targeted job queued by devon

devon: rerun finished — same failure, same permission error

tara: consistent failure => bisect seems next. max can you git-bisect between abc123 (last green) and def456 (current head)? I can take it if you prefer.

max: plan:
1) one more canary rerun (devon running)
2) if still failing -> bisect to find first bad commit
3) if bisect points at infra/tooling change, involve infra for node repro/provision
4) hold merge if we can't quickly fix; otherwise merge once green and approved
Any objections? :thumbsup:

ryan: no objections. looks infra-related, not snapshots.

devon: I'll run bisect if canary fails. otherwise I can approve once green. +1

sophie: working on repro now, will post results. if it's /tmp perms I can try node repro and check Docker image layer changes.

max: thanks — devon is running the rerun now. I'll post back with the result and bisect status. If someone else wants to bisect lmk.
